scope: nominal dataset-label crosswalk for external stress tests; operating point and clinical validity unassessed
qualifications: The PAD article pools Bowen disease with SCC. HAM places Bowen disease with actinic keratoses under akiec.
HAM bkl includes seborrheic keratoses, solar lentigines and lichen-planus-like keratoses. PAD SEK is narrower.
The PAD authors' supplement maps to a mixture of disorder and morphologic abnormality concepts. The listed coarse nodes are operational and do not assert direct SNOMED CT parentage.
Counts of the three shared labels condition on the reference diagnosis. This subset does not represent deployment with an unknown diagnosis.
